summary.text: Diane Larson is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 30 (Bismarck) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Diane Larson's service as "House 1989-90, 2013-16; Senate since 2017". The member page lists Diane Larson's committee assignments as including Judiciary (Chairman) and the Workforce Development standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Diane Larson's occupation as Retired, Youth Worker, Bismarck Police Department.
It lists education as AA, BSC; BS, Ed, UND.

It lists these affiliations and civic roles: National Conference of State Legislatures: Co-Chair, Law, Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee; Interstate Commission on Juveniles; Governor’s Juvenile Justice Advisory Group; ND Commission on Juvenile Justice; Board, Children’s Advocacy Center; Legislator Service Award (2023), State Bar Association.
Diane Larson is listed as married to Greg with 2 children and 4 grandchildren.
